chunks: When Joseph told his father: "O my father, I saw eleven stars and the sun and the moon bowing before me in homage"
ai.seo_question: What does the dream of eleven stars, the sun, and the moon signify in the story of Prophet Joseph?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this dream is viewed as a divine prefiguration of the twelve Imams, with the sun and moon representing the Prophet Muhammad and Imam Ali (AS), establishing the foundational hierarchy of the Ahl al-Bayt. The prostration (sujud) signifies not merely future political authority but the spiritual supremacy and obedience due to the Infallibles, a theme central to Shia theology regarding the Imamate.
